headline: F1 The official Laws of Fiji consolidation is more than two budgets behind: it still prints ss 28A and 125A, which Act 5 of 2024 deleted from 1 August 2024, and its Table of Amendments stops at Act 5 of 2023

scale.source: Income Tax (Rates of Tax and Levies) Regulations 2016 Schedule para (1) as amended by LN 55 of 2023 (in force 1 January 2024, unchanged in 2025): start of the 20 % band ("50,001-270,000 | $3,600 + 20% of excess over $50,000")
scale.basis: Income Tax (Rates of Tax and Levies) Regulations 2016 Schedule para (1) as amended by LN 55 of 2023 (in force 1 January 2024, unchanged in 2025): start of the 20 % band ("50,001-270,000 | $3,600 + 20% of excess over $50,000"). A statutory threshold, not an average wage: 1 'AW' in scanner output = this amount of annual income.

registry_correction: Registry 'Income Tax Act 2015' confirmed; the rates are in the Income Tax (Rates of Tax and Levies) Regulations 2016 Schedule (resident 0/18/20/33/34/35/36/37/38/39 % with 30,000 tax-free; non-resident 20 % from the first dollar); Social Responsibility Tax abolished from 1 January 2024 (Act 5 of 2023); dividends exempt; bank interest 10 % final; FNPF employee 8 % (s 37(4) 18 % x s 39 8/18), not deductible.
